content:
From: Makarius <makarius@sketis.net>

The all-important fork of the isabelle-dev vs. isabelle-release will happen
03-Oct-2026 12:00 Royal Bavarian Time.

Afterwards anything pushed on the isabelle-dev repository will be for the next
release, after Isabelle2026 (October 2026). Anything for the current release
needs to be send to be via E-Mail (e.g. result from "hg export").

We still have a few odd technical problems to sort out, e.g. the question if
z3 really works on arm64-darwin and arm64-linux.

In the meantime NEWS and CONTRIBUTORS might need additional attention.

Makarius
